purpose: legislators:PK:Khyber Pakhtunkhwa:general seats for constituencies PK-1 to PK-50
query: List the CURRENT members of the Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan) holding the general seats for constituencies PK-1 to PK-50, as of 2026-11-15. For each member give full name, constituency code and name (for constituency seats), seat type (general, women_reserved, minority_reserved, other_reserved), party name and acronym, term start, whether the seat was won in a by-election, and source URLs that list this person as a member for this seat. Account for by-elections, deaths, resignations and disqualifications since the general election; omit vacant seats.
text: The 50 currently listed general-seat members for PK-1–PK-50 are included. PK-22 was won in a July 2024 by-election; its current member took the assembly oath on 29 July 2024. Party affiliations follow the Election Commission’s later party-position list, which classifies most members as independent.
